items.title: Bump 8 timeoutMs entries from default 60s to 180s
items.context: In packages/main/smoke-manifest.json, set timeoutMs=180000 for these 8 entries (or add the entry if missing): experience-layer-digest-extract, gap-log, init-check-fallback, scope-contract, story-capsule, story-create-concurrency, story-metadata-protection, unattended-dispatch. Each PASSES standalone in 9-21s — the 60s default is enough for serial but not for parallel worker-pool load. Bump margin: ~3x measured standalone.
items.userSees: `grep -A1 timeoutMs packages/main/smoke-manifest.json` shows 180000 for the 8 named entries (including the new experience-layer-digest-extract entry).

happy.desc: 7 existing manifest entries have timeoutMs=180000 -> `python3 -c "import json;m=json.load(open(\"packages/main/smoke-manifest.json\"));targets=[\"gap-log\",\"init-check-fallback\",\"scope-contract\",\"story-capsule\",\"story-create-concurrency\",\"story-metadata-protection\",\"unattended-dispatch\"];print(sum(1 for s in m[\"smokes\"] if s[\"name\"] in targets and s.get(\"timeoutMs\")==180000))"` outputs 7; WHY: each entry must be bumped to 180000

experience-layer-digest-extract added to manifest with timeoutMs=180000 -> `python3 -c "import json;m=json.load(open(\"packages/main/smoke-manifest.json\"));e=[s for s in m[\"smokes\"] if s[\"name\"]==\"experience-layer-digest-extract\"];print(\"OK\" if e and e[0].get(\"timeoutMs\")==180000 else \"MISSING\")"` prints OK; WHY: smoke was discovered via directory-scan, now has explicit manifest entry

edge.desc: smoke-manifest.json valid JSON -> `node -e "JSON.parse(require(\"fs\").readFileSync(\"./packages/main/smoke-manifest.json\",\"utf8\"))";echo OK` prints OK; WHY: must remain parseable
run-all-smokes-smoke self-smoke still passes -> `node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.js > /tmp/b24c3-self.log 2>&1; echo $?` outputs 0; WHY: per pre-mortem D2 dedup check

adversarial.desc: OVER-REACH: only the 8 named entries changed (no other smokes affected) -> `git diff main...HEAD -- packages/main/smoke-manifest.json | grep -E "^[+].*name" | grep -vE "gap-log|init-check-fallback|scope-contract|story-capsule|story-create-concurrency|story-metadata-protection|unattended-dispatch|experience-layer-digest-extract" | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: scope-boundary specifies these 8 only (and lattice-baseline in CHK-002)

items.title: Bump lattice-baseline timeoutMs from 240000 to 360000
items.context: lattice-baseline currently has timeoutMs=240000 (set by B-2d6c). Serial standalone wall-time is 129s. Under heavy parallel load it now times out at 240s. Bump to 360000 (~3x serial standalone) to give consistent headroom. Do NOT change smoke logic.
items.userSees: `python3 -c 'import json;m=json.load(open("packages/main/smoke-manifest.json"));print([s for s in m["smokes"] if s["name"]=="lattice-baseline"][0])'` shows timeoutMs=360000.

happy.desc: lattice-baseline timeoutMs is 360000 -> `python3 -c "import json;m=json.load(open(\"packages/main/smoke-manifest.json\"));e=[s for s in m[\"smokes\"] if s[\"name\"]==\"lattice-baseline\"];print(e[0].get(\"timeoutMs\") if e else \"MISSING\")"` outputs 360000; WHY: bump from 240000 to 360000

edge.desc: lattice-baseline serial still PASS within bumped timeout -> `node packages/main/dist/tasks/lattice-baseline-smoke.js > /tmp/b24c3-lbl.log 2>&1; echo $?` outputs 0; WHY: smoke runs cleanly

adversarial.desc: OVER-REACH: only timeoutMs key changed for lattice-baseline -> `git diff main...HEAD -- packages/main/smoke-manifest.json | grep -B1 -A1 "lattice-baseline" | grep -cE "^[+].*(skip|tags)"` outputs 0; WHY: only timeoutMs key allowed to change

items.title: CHANGELOG Unreleased entry + 3x parallel verify
items.context: CHANGELOG Unreleased entry under Test infrastructure subsection naming this story (B-24c3) and listing the 9 timeoutMs bumps. Final verification: 3 consecutive `npm run test:all` runs all exit 0 with 162/162 PASS (no flake). If a run still fails for review-pass-discard (parallel-only FAIL, not a timeout), that is OUT OF SCOPE — file finding_add as a separate concern, leave the smoke as-is.
